title: Global NCAP (10 Nov 2026): the Indian-built Renault Kiger, updated with six airbags, ESC and ISOFIX as standard, goes from 2 to 4 stars (adult) and 1 to 3 stars (child) in the Safer Cars for Africa test; a door opened in the side impact; India-spec Kiger (from ₹5.81 lakh ex-showroom) not tested
